Merge pull request #263 from input-output-hk/jhbertra/stylish

Changes to stylish-haskell config
Add module header rule to stylish haskell
Add language pragma rules to stylish haskell
Add import rules to stylish Haskell
SCP-4374: Added ACTUS contract type SWAPS

ACTUS module refactorings

* Reintroduced minimal type-classes for Actus operations: `ActusOps` and
  `ActusFrac` without dependencies to `Eq` and `Ord`
* Use core semantics for reduction of Values
* Fixed test-cases
SCP-3103: Added CEC (collateral) ACTUS contract type

Refactoring of actus-core

* Got rid of ActusNum, ActusOps, etc. in favor of standard numerical
  type classes
* More granular functions in state transitions
* Renaming (prefer longer, more informative names)

SCP-3192: Actus module refactoring

* Split actus-core and Marlowe specific code
* Module renaming
* Dropped quick-check tests
SCP-3192: Moved quick-check tests to actus-core
SCP-3192: split code into separate modules
